feature: V6 optional steep natural-rock albedo projection
status: validated locally; default off; not published or installed

source_reference.metadata_credit: Pinned terrain_tile_presets.h credits ei-mapper-endurance af24d45 editor family metadata.

scope.change: Side projection of the existing original tile artwork on verified plain natural-rock slopes; separate helpers keep EITerrain integration small.
scope.existing_behavior: Existing tile edge blending, ground families, painted relief, macro variation, wet-bank response and original triangle geometry remain authoritative.
scope.classification: Only original 512x512 RGBA8 atlas fingerprints and slots whose four nonzero authored corners are the same Stone/Rock family. Unknown/modified atlases, transitions, paving/path slots, unsupported packed flags, unknown/snow/ice/liquid ground types, invalid normals and folded/nonfinite geometry are neutral.
scope.projection: Original padded tile sampler and packed rotation, unwrapped derivatives, two side planes with two-metre repeat, slope fade from 40 to 55 degrees, distance fade 80 to 140 metres, adjacent-facet flat-ledge guard and symmetric eligible-neighbour blending. The stretched painted-normal relief fades with side albedo.
scope.integration: The terrain, native colour-cache live material and rigid-scenery contact sampler share the same optional helper source and fields. The underlying cache bake is unchanged. No extra draw calls or geometry, navigation, collision, save or network mutation.
scope.lifetime: World-scoped helper, two bounded R8 textures only when steep verified rock is admitted, source/material variants retired on disable, resources released with terrain. Unsupported fields return original shader source. Maximum inspected grid vertices 1100000.
not_implemented: Geometry rounding or edited terrain silhouettes
New animated-tile interpretation or animation tables
Feature inference from a texture name or visual resemblance

metadata.preset: Applied-option registration; tier-2 automatic/all-on clears this field. Custom opt-in only.

build.base_revision: 4a595dc plus committed cloud integration/metadata and this isolated V6 work
build.build_notes: Build5 has final cliff helper/contact/cache sources; build6 includes the parent cloud empty-material fallback in terrain. Build7 adds the parent contact-light cloud sun fix. All basic and cached render evidence uses build6; final census/composition uses build7. No production source changed during exports.

independent_image_audit.method: Pillow RGB decode; per-pixel maximum of all three channel deltas
independent_image_audit.correction: Initial basic Vulkan fixture captures were RGB8, while its difference loop assumed RGBA8. Original manifests and PNGs are preserved. This independent full-RGB PNG audit supersedes their pixel metrics and proves every strict control. The final fixture normalizes images to RGBA8 before comparing; final composed runs use that correction.

visual_review: Base zone1 and zone11 Compatibility off/on, base zone15 Forward+ on: fine rock detail replaces severe stretching on eligible steep faces while neighbouring authored transition art remains original.
LiA zone26 off/on: steep coherent rock walls retain the original silhouettes with smaller side-projected grain. LiA zone6 unknown atlas: zero changed pixels and no feature textures.
Final composed zone11: clouds, material lighting, surface weather, water caustics/current/interaction/waves and contact blending compile and render together across Compatibility, Mobile and Forward+.

fixture_repairs.cause: Fixture captured its baseline before installing the native colour cache; load_map builds before tree entry. Explicit apply_gfx plus cache.prepare(camera) now runs before the baseline. Settled run passes 255 checks, including exact controls and texture release. No production cache change was needed.

The initial off capture differed at 67 scattered water pixels, peak 4/255; later unclassified and disabled images were byte-identical, and on/restored were byte-identical. Increased the initial combined-program settle from 60 to 180 frames for asynchronous native Vulkan specialization, retained exact assertions, and reran all three renderers with the parent cloud/contact fix.

limitations: Desktop NVIDIA RTX 3090 evidence; no Android, integrated-GPU, thermal, memory-pressure or performance/FPS claim.
Classification is synchronous on first opt-in per terrain and can cause a one-time hitch. Census build timings are diagnostics, not a frame-time benchmark.
Only verified plain original rock tiles participate. Transition artwork, unknown LiA art and custom textures deliberately receive no cliff projection.

Two additional terrain sampler fields and side atlas reads exist only for admitted opt-in worlds. Combination tests are fixed local shader/scene controls; parent integrated game lifecycle tests are separate.
No geometric rounding was attempted because preserving original grounding and winding is more important than speculative smoothing.
